title: ollama/ollama: Release v0.40.14

topic.reason: Neue KI-Modelle, Funktionen, Benchmarks (Treffer: model, gpt, llama)

summary: Offizielle Release-Notes (v0.40.14): ## What's Changed * `ollama launch claude` now applies the model's output token limit for Claude Code, so cloud models no longer run into the 128k default cap * Cloud web search responses on `/api/chat` are now decoded correctly, including compressed responses * OpenAI-compatible endpoints no longer override a model's packaged sampler defaults — clients that send no `temperature`/`top_p` get the model's own values instead of 1.0, matching `/api/chat` * `/v1/responses` now preserves readable input content, including prior assistant refusals, instead of flattening it * Ollama's app can now retry ChatGPT disconnect failures instead of leaving the connection in a broken state * `ollama launch codex` verifies ChatGPT routing before configuring, and reports a clear error when routing is unavailable * Faster top-k sampling on MLX for large vocabularies **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ollama/ollama/compare/v0.40.13...v0.40.14
